title: Would you Rather (Русский)
description: Russian Translation Pack for the Would You Rather mod!
body:
Russian Translation Pack for the Would You Rather mod!

This resource pack translates the mod’s interface, questions, and most of the in-game text into Russian.
Perfect for comfortable gameplay with friends without needing to know English.

✔ Fully translated interface
✔ Questions and answers translated
✔ Support for the latest mod versions
✔ Easy installation

Installation:

Download the translation pack
Move the file into the resourcepacks folder
Enable the resource pack in Minecraft settings

Enjoy the game!
